rule: .questlife-dialog { max-width: min(460px, calc(100vw - 32px)); max-height: calc(100dvh - 32px); overflow: auto; padding: 24px; border: 2px solid #e8dfd5; border-radius: 20px; background: #fffcf5; color: #3d3438; font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; }
.questlife-dialog button { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e8dfd5; color: #3d3438; background: white; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; }
